title: Volcano Chaiten, Chile
author: NASA/GSFC/METI/ERSDAC/JAROS, and U.S./Japan ASTER Science Team
description: Chaiten Volcano, Chile continues to erupt after first exploding in May 2008 following about 9,000 years of inactivity. This image from NASA Terra spacecraft shows vegetation in red. You can clearly see the extent of the plume.
